Theorem
[Li--Yau upper heat-kernel bound] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0342 ↗ def:chow-ii-ch16-avr 1. ch16:16.13\group Heat Kernel Bounds

If $\operatorname {Rc}\ge 0$, then for every $\delta \in (0,1)$, \[ H(x,y,\tau )\le \frac{C(n,\delta )}{\operatorname {Vol}B(x,\sqrt\tau )} \exp \! \left(-\frac{d(x,y)^2}{(4+\delta )\tau }\right). \] If $\operatorname {AVR}(g)>0$, the denominator may be replaced by $\omega _n\operatorname {AVR}(g)\tau ^{n/2}$.
